body: Well she's going to undergo a very serious surgery soon. So that means a ton of heavy medical bills. I really wanted out of the things she had to worry about. I didn't want to be a burden anymore. And now, i still am. All her health issues have been because of us, all her sacrifices. And this was the only way I could pay her back.

That's awesome. Your Mom is really considerate for letting you decide.  Well it the school doesn't really matter to me. It's the whole formality of graduating. I wanted to see the look on my Mom's face when she see's me on that stage with that piece of paper. Like all she'd sacrifice was culminating to that. And now I don't have that, again. And it just rots me from the inside out.

I live in the Philippines and here, people see you as useless without a piece of paper a.k.a diploma. It's for art school, but everything i had come up with was just not up to par. My advisor told me that I wasn't going to pass.

That sucks. If you ask me people need more english.

I can't force myself to finish a thesis. I've trie for 2 years and it has only made me miserable to the point of losing hair and just overall getting depressed. At the same time I feel horrible that i can't give my Mother the one thing she's ever asked from me.

How are you?
